_doc: CAD spec for T8 BLISTER SYRINGE hero. Layout from canonical target (tmp/discovery/T8_target.png, 648x934). A clear plastic blister clamshell pack standing vertical, containing a single prefilled SYRINGE (amber/orange liquid visible, plunger + finger flange) laid diagonally, with a small printed paper backing CARD inside the blister carrying the branding/label text. Set on white. Swappable text = the card (Regenic|Lab + product name + dose + form). gpt_image_2 generative + reference; prompt defers to reference. SKUs: tirzepatide, nad-injection (Section 21/Unscheduled -> NO badge).

object.scene: clear thermoformed blister clamshell, vertical, with a single prefilled syringe (amber liquid, plunger, finger flange) and a printed paper backing card inside
object.label_on_card: Regenic|Lab + product name + dose + form, navy text, small

artwork.swappable: ONLY the printed backing card text (product name, dose, form). The blister, syringe and amber liquid are fixed by the reference.

scene.framing: blister vertically centered ~88% frame height, portrait
scene.lighting: soft key top-left, gentle reflections on the clear plastic

prompt_template: Photorealistic e-commerce hero render of a single-use prefilled syringe in a clear blister pack. Match the attached reference image EXACTLY and reproduce the whole pack faithfully — change ONLY the printed text on the backing card. SCENE: a clear thermoformed plastic blister clamshell standing vertical, containing one prefilled syringe with amber/orange liquid, visible plunger and finger flange, laid diagonally, plus a printed paper backing card behind it. CAMERA: straight-on front, blister vertically centered ~88% of frame height, portrait. LIGHTING: soft key top-left with gentle realistic reflections on the clear plastic; seamless very-light grey background, soft contact shadow. The printed backing card is a soft off-white / very light warm grey (NOT a glaring pure bright white) — keep its brightness slightly muted. ON THE BACKING CARD, small neat navy #1b2846 text, left-aligned: the 'Regenic|Lab' wordmark with cyan accent, the product name '{product_name}' (Montserrat SemiBold, largest on the card), {dose_clause}and a small muted-grey 'SC · Single-use Syringe'. TYPOGRAPHY DISCIPLINE: keep the card text small, crisp and legible exactly as in the reference; do not enlarge or add text elsewhere; if no dose is specified do NOT invent one. There is NO schedule badge. Do NOT print 'Novecy' or any third-party/compounder branding. Clean premium clinical pharmacy, sharp focus, sRGB. Portrait 648x934.
